summary: The app's places down the window's start: a head with the mark and the name, groups of entries, and a foot cell for the account. Expanded, collapsed to its icons, or a strip of labeled icons; its end edge resizes it, and pulled outward expands a collapsed rail.

anatomy.frame: The rail's column, the window's full height: the sidebar ground and a 1px edge at its end.
anatomy.head: As tall as the top bar, so the top bar's rule ends level with it; it draws no rule of its own, in the frame or in the drawer. Expanded: the mark and the name (a link home with markHref), and at its end the collapse control, or in the shell's drawer the control that closes the drawer. Collapsed: the mark alone, which is the control that expands the rail.
anatomy.mark: The app's mark on a square tile. Collapsed, under the pointer the expand icon shows in the mark's place.
anatomy.name: The app's name beside the mark, cut short with an ellipsis.
anatomy.home: The mark and the name as one link to the app's home, given markHref.
anatomy.collapse: The control at the expanded head's end: narrows the rail to its icons, or in the drawer closes the drawer.
anatomy.groupTitle: A group's title over its entries, upper case. A group without a title stands at the top.
anatomy.groupRule: A collapsed rail's rule in a group title's place.
anatomy.entry: One place in the expanded rail: its mark (an icon, a color dot, or nothing for a rail of text), its label, an optional description under the label, and at its end a count, an unread dot or a parent's chevron. The active one wears a bar at its start over a wash.
anatomy.description: An entry's second line, under its label, saying what the place holds; it wraps.
anatomy.count: How many wait at a place, at the expanded row's end.
anatomy.cornerCount: A count at an icon's upper corner, in a collapsed rail and a strip, cut out of the rail's ground.
anatomy.unreadDot: Something new at a place without a number: a dot where a count would stand.
anatomy.chevron: A parent's fold mark at its row's end, turned while its entries are unfolded under it.
anatomy.chevronButton: The chevron's own button, for a parent that has a page of its own; a parent without one folds on a press anywhere on its row.
anatomy.children: A parent's entries, unfolded under it in the expanded rail, their labels lined up under the parent's label.
anatomy.iconEntry: One place in the collapsed rail: a tile with its icon alone, named in a tooltip beside it.
anatomy.tooltip: A collapsed entry's label, then its description, beside it at the rail's end.
anatomy.flyout: A parent's entries in a popover beside a collapsed rail or a strip, under the parent's label as a group title; a link chosen there closes it.
anatomy.edge: The resize handle along the rail's end edge: a line in the accent while hovered, focused or dragged, nothing otherwise.
anatomy.footCell: The account control's cell at the rail's foot, as tall as the status line and level with it.
anatomy.back: With a body: the row at the top that shows the places again (words.places), under the head.
anatomy.body: App content the expanded rail holds in place of its groups, such as a tree with its search; kept as it was while the places or the icons show.
anatomy.strip: The strip variant's column: the workspace's tile at the top, each entry a tile over its short label, the foot's items stacked at the bottom.
anatomy.stripEntry: One place in the strip: a tile with its icon, a count or dot at the tile's corner, and its short label under it.
anatomy.stripTile: A strip entry's tile, washed while its place is shown.

groups.does: The places: [{ id, title?, entries, onReorder? }], each entry { id, label, description?, icon?, href?, active?, count?, unread?, dot?, keywords?, entries?, drop? }. Data, the same on every target; the palette lists them too.

variant.does: nav: the app's navigation, expanded or collapsed. strip: a narrow column of labeled icons, which neither collapses nor resizes.

collapsed.does: Narrowed to its icons; kept by the app, which hears the reader's change in onCollapsedChange. Without onCollapsedChange the rail draws no collapse control.

mark.does: The app's mark on the head's tile; in a strip, the workspace's tile.

markHref.does: Makes the expanded head's mark and name, and a strip's tile, a link to the app's home.

foot.does: What stands in the foot cell, normally the account control; in a strip, the items stacked at its foot.

resizable.does: Whether the expanded rail's edge drags to resize it, and a collapsed rail's to expand it.

size.does: The expanded width; held by the rail itself from defaultSize unless the app holds it with onSizeChange. minSize 200 and maxSize 360 bound a drag.

expanded.does: The ids of the unfolded parents. A parent holding the active entry starts unfolded; defaultExpanded adds to those.

defaultFlyout.does: The parent whose flyout stands open at the start, in a collapsed rail or a strip.

body.does: Content held in place of the groups in the expanded rail: { content, title?, search? }, under the back row. Collapsed, the rail draws the places' icons.

view.does: With a body, whether the expanded rail shows its places or the body; a place chosen among the places brings the body back.

narrowed.does: The shell asks the rail narrowed to its icons (railMode collapsed, useRailMode, or an open panel on a window under 1280): it draws collapsed whatever the app holds, and its mark and edge widen it for the reader until the ask changes.

inDrawer.does: Drawn in the shell's drawer below 768: expanded whatever the app holds, without its edge, the head's end control closing the drawer (the shell's words.close).

docked.does: In a shell with a foot or a bottom strip: the foot cell stands in the shell's foot row under the rail's column, level with the status line, on the foot's ground.

trafficLights.does: In a desktop window with its title bar hidden: the head is the window's drag region and leaves spacing-traffic-lights at its start for the window's buttons; a collapsed rail or a strip, narrower than that room, keeps its head empty and its mark just below it.

mark.note: In a strip the workspace's tile is 36 square.

entry.note: The start pad holds the active bar: 2, then 10 to the icon. A finger tall below 768. A row with a chevron button pads its end 36.

describedEntry.note: At least density.row, growing to hold the description (text.help) under the label; the icon, the count and the dot stand level with the label's line.

groupTitle.note: Inside the group's own 8: 16 from the rail's start. Upper case, tracked 0.025em.

edge.note: The hit area, straddling the rail's end edge; the line drawn in it is 2 wide.

width.note: Expanded, by default (defaultSize); a double click on the edge or Enter puts it back.

groupPadX.note: Each group's own pad, across: an expanded entry runs from 8 to 9 short of the rail's end (8 and the edge).

entryGap.note: Between entries, and between a group title and its first entry.

groupTitleTop.note: Above a group's title; a collapsed rail keeps the same room around its rule.

groupTitleLine.note: The title's line (text.badge); a collapsed rail centers its 1px rule in it.

untitledTop.note: Above the first entry of a group without a title at the top of the places: room inside the scroller for the entry's focus look.

placesBottom.note: Under the last group, inside the scroller.

entryCornerStart.note: An expanded entry's start corners, beside the bar, in every state.

activeBar.note: The active entry's bar, inside the start of its row.

childInsetIcon.note: A child row's start pad under a parent with an icon, so its label stands under the parent's.

childInsetText.note: A child row's start pad in a rail of text.

cornerCount.note: Tall and at least as wide, fully round, 11 text at 600; 4 above the icon's tile and 6 past its end; 99+ above 99.

unreadDot.note: Round. Over an icon's corner it stands 4 in from the tile's corner (2 in a strip).

resizeStep.note: What an arrow on the edge moves it.

flyoutGap.note: Beside a collapsed rail; 8 beside a strip.

stripGap.note: Between a strip's entries and between its groups, a 32 wide rule between groups.

stripLabel.note: A strip entry's label: 11/16 (text-2xs), the one size no text role has; 2 under its tile.

trafficLights.note: The head's start pad in a desktop window with its title bar hidden.

widthEase.note: ms the width eases over as the rail collapses or expands, as far as motion allows; no motion token yet.

rest.means: An entry that is not the place shown, nothing over it.

hover.means: The pointer over an entry, a head control, a strip entry or the edge.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the home link, a head control, an entry or the edge.
focus.sokkel-ui: focus-visible: every control of the rail (the home link, the head's control, the collapsed mark, an expanded, icon or strip entry, a parent's chevron button) draws the button's own focus look, a 2px ring outline 2 off; the edge shows its line.

active.means: The entry of the place shown; a parent folded over the active entry wears it too.

holding.means: A parent unfolded over the active entry: its label set apart while its child wears the accent.

open.means: A parent's entries shown: unfolded under its row in the expanded rail (the chevron turned 90 degrees), or in a flyout beside a collapsed rail or a strip.
open.reached: a press on a parent or its chevron, ArrowRight, defaultExpanded, defaultFlyout

collapsed.means: The rail narrowed to its icons: icon entries named in tooltips, a rule in each group title's place, the mark the control that expands it.
collapsed.reached: collapsed, the head's collapse control, narrowed

docked.means: The foot cell in the shell's foot row, level with the status line, on the foot's ground.
docked.reached: a Shell with a foot or a bottom strip

drawer.means: Below 768, the rail in the shell's drawer: expanded, without its edge, its head's control closing the drawer.

rest.note: The edge is at the end only, 1px.
No rule under it, in the frame or in the drawer: the top bar's rule ends at the rail's edge.

focus.note: Collapsed, the mark is the control that expands the rail.

rest.note: 1 tall across the group's width, centered in the title's line.
The edge is the 2 wide bar inside the row's start, drawn only when active.
13/20 (text-xs) at 600 with tabular figures; no text role has that weight.
The ring cuts it out of the rail's ground.
Over an icon's corner, ringed 2 in sidebar so it reads as cut out.

open.note: A parent while its flyout is open.

rest.note: The label, then the description in muted-foreground; elevation-pop under it.
A 2 wide line centered on the rail's end edge.
On the rail's own ground, a rule above it.

docked.note: Its end edge in border-strong, continuing the rail's.

open.note: A parent while its flyout is open.

keyboard.does: Reaches the home link, the head's control, each entry (a parent's row, or its link and its chevron button), and the edge.
Follows an entry's link; on a parent without a page of its own, folds or unfolds it; on a collapsed parent, opens its flyout.
Unfolds the parent whose row has focus.
keyboard.when: a folded parent in the expanded rail

keyboard.does: Folds the parent whose row has focus; from one of its entries, folds it and moves focus to its row.
keyboard.when: an unfolded parent in the expanded rail, or one of its entries

keyboard.does: On a collapsed rail's edge: expands the rail.
On the expanded rail's edge: 16 narrower or wider a press, the narrowest or the widest, and Enter (or a double click) puts back defaultSize.
keyboard.when: the expanded rail's edge has focus

keyboard.does: Moves the focused entry a place in its group; focus stays on it.
keyboard.when: a group with onReorder, inside RailDrops

keyboard.does: Closes an open flyout, focus back on its parent; in the shell's drawer, closes the drawer.

appText.name: The app's name beside its mark; the name of each group without a title.
appText.places: Every group's title, every entry's label and description, and the keywords the palette finds a place by.
appText.body: A body's title and its content.

sokkel-ui: Each entry's link and the home link are Link, drawn as the app's LinkProvider says, so a middle click opens a tab; the active entry says aria-current=page.
The collapsed rail's tooltips and the flyouts are Base UI's; a flyout opened from the keyboard focuses its first entry.
The width eases over 200 ms (transition-[width]) as far as the document's motion allows.
Reordering loads the drag engine only inside RailDrops; a press that does not move still follows the link, and a finger holds a moment before it drags.
A body stays mounted while hidden, so a tree's open levels and its scroll come back as left.
In a desktop window (Shell desktop) the head is a window drag region (data-window-drag).
sokkel-ui-egui: There are no URLs: a press on an entry sets the app's active place, which the app routes by.
The rail fills the rect the Shell gives it; a width the reader drags is app state the Shell is told.
A collapsed entry's name shows in the library's tooltip.
Keyboard-only focus needs the last input kind tracked, as for every part.
